items_flat.title_en: Google DeepMind and Cloud open frontier science models to 200 European researchers
items_flat.title_zh: Google DeepMind與Cloud向200名歐洲研究人員開放前沿科學模型
items_flat.summary_en: Google DeepMind and Google Cloud announced they will give up to 200 European scientific researchers direct access to frontier models including AlphaFold 3, WeatherNext, AlphaGenome, AlphaEvolve, and AlphaEarth Foundations, plus $3 million in compute credits. The pledge supports the European Commission’s RAISE initiative to help close the compute gap for European science.
items_flat.summary_zh: Google DeepMind與Google Cloud宣布，將向最多200名歐洲科學研究人員直接開放AlphaFold 3、WeatherNext、AlphaGenome、AlphaEvolve與AlphaEarth Foundations等前沿模型，並提供300萬美元算力額度。此承諾支持歐盟執行委員會的RAISE計畫，協助縮小歐洲科學研究的算力落差。
items_flat.analysis_en: Providing controlled access to specialized science models through an existing EU program is a concrete step that can accelerate work in protein structure, weather, and genomics without requiring researchers to build their own large-scale infrastructure. Selection criteria, start timing, and credit allocation remain unspecified, so the practical impact is still unclear.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 透過既有歐盟計畫提供受控的專業科學模型存取，是可加速蛋白質結構、氣象與基因體研究的具體步驟，無需研究人員自建大規模基礎設施。人選標準、啟動時程與額度分配仍未說明，實際影響仍待觀察。
items_flat.quote: Google DeepMind and Google Cloud are providing up to 200 top European scientific researchers with direct access to our frontier models, together with $3 million in compute credits.
items_flat.quote_zh: Google DeepMind與Google Cloud正為最多200名頂尖歐洲科學研究人員提供我們前沿模型的直接存取，以及300萬美元的算力額度。

items_flat.title_en: Anthropic builds Scion to replace Git after Claude drives merges past 30,000 per day
items_flat.title_zh: Anthropic建置Scion取代Git，因Claude帶動每日合併量突破3萬
items_flat.summary_en: Anthropic published an engineering post describing how it built Scion, an in-house always-online version-control system, and migrated its monorepo from Git in five months. Daily merges grew from roughly 2,500 in May 2026 to more than 30,000 by September as Claude wrote far more code; the company reports Scion uses ~200× less CPU/memory than its prior Git mirroring setup and makes checkouts ~100× faster.
items_flat.summary_zh: Anthropic發表工程文章，說明如何在五個月內建置名為Scion的內部永遠在線版本控制系統，並將單一倉庫從Git遷移過去。2026年5月每日合併約2,500次，至9月因Claude大量寫碼而超過3萬次；公司表示Scion的CPU與記憶體用量約為先前Git鏡像的1/200，簽出速度約快100倍。
items_flat.analysis_en: This is one of the clearest public examples of agent-driven code volume forcing infrastructure redesigns that human-scale tools like Git were not built for. The performance gains are substantial for Anthropic’s workload, but it is still unknown how transferable the design will be to other organizations or whether similar pressures will appear more widely in the next 6–12 months.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 這是代理驅動程式碼量迫使基礎設施重新設計的最清晰公開案例之一，傳統為人類規模設計的Git並未為此而生。對Anthropic的工作負載而言效能提升顯著，但設計能否轉移到其他組織，或類似壓力是否會在未來6至12個月更廣泛出現，仍未知。
items_flat.quote: In May 2026, Anthropic averaged around 2,500 code changes merged per day; as of September, we merged over 30,000 per day. The bottleneck, now, is all of the developer infrastructure built for human scale.
items_flat.quote_zh: 2026年5月，Anthropic平均每天合併約2,500項程式碼變更；到9月，我們每天合併超過3萬項。現在的瓶頸，是所有為人類規模所建的開發者基礎設施。

items_flat.title_en: Anthropic opens Singapore office and signs MOU with government on AI safety
items_flat.title_zh: Anthropic在新加坡開設辦公室並與政府簽署AI安全合作備忘錄
items_flat.summary_en: Anthropic announced the opening of its fifth Asia-Pacific office in Singapore and signed a Memorandum of Understanding with Singapore’s Ministry of Digital Development and Information. The MOU covers cooperation on AI safety, security, model evaluation, research on adoption impacts, and responsible use across public and private sectors. Singapore ranks second globally in Claude.ai usage relative to population, and local partners already include GovTech, DBS, and Grab.
items_flat.summary_zh: Anthropic宣布在新加坡開設亞太第五間辦公室，並與新加坡數位發展與資訊部簽署合作備忘錄。協議涵蓋AI安全、資安、模型評估、採用影響研究，以及公私部門的負責任採用。新加坡在Claude.ai使用量（相對人口）全球排名第二，合作對象包括GovTech、星展銀行與Grab等。
items_flat.analysis_en: The move strengthens Anthropic’s presence in a high-adoption, regulation-conscious market and gives the Singapore government structured access to technical exchanges on evaluation and incident response. Whether the MOU produces concrete shared standards or remains largely symbolic will depend on follow-through in the coming months.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 此舉強化Anthropic在高採用且重視監管市場的布局，並讓新加坡政府獲得模型評估與事件回應的技術交流管道。備忘錄能否產生具體共享標準，或僅停留在象徵層次，仍取決於後續執行。
items_flat.quote: Singapore has been a leader in responsible AI, with a long track record of investment in model testing and evaluation. We founded Anthropic on the belief that capability and safety have to go hand in hand.
items_flat.quote_zh: 新加坡一直是負責任AI的領導者，長期投資於模型測試與評估。我們創立Anthropic的信念是，能力與安全必須齊頭並進。

items_flat.title_en: Google Research@ 2026 highlights milestones in health, climate, and scientific AI
items_flat.title_zh: Google Research@ 2026強調健康、氣候與科學AI里程碑
items_flat.summary_en: Google Research published a recap of its Research@ 2026 event, highlighting progress on tools such as AMIE for clinical use, Earth AI for public health, Project Suncatcher for orbital ML hardware, and top-ranked flu hospitalization forecasting. The post frames the work as putting advanced AI capabilities into the hands of domain experts.
items_flat.summary_zh: Google Research發表Research@ 2026活動回顧，強調AMIE臨床應用、Earth AI公共衛生、Project Suncatcher軌道ML硬體，以及流感住院預測排名第一等進展。文章將這些工作定位為把先進AI能力交到領域專家手中。
items_flat.analysis_en: The post consolidates several ongoing scientific efforts rather than announcing a single new model or product. Its value is mainly as a status update on how Google is applying existing research systems to real-world health and environmental problems.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 這篇文章彙整多項進行中的科學工作，而非宣布單一新模型或產品。其價值主要在於說明Google如何將現有研究系統應用於真實世界的健康與環境問題。
items_flat.quote: This is the golden age of research and scientific discovery. Today, more than ever, we can push the frontiers and ask the most audacious questions that can have transformative impact on products, science, and society.
items_flat.quote_zh: 這是研究與科學發現的黃金時代。今天比以往任何時候，我們更能推進邊界，提出可能對產品、科學與社會產生轉型影響的最大膽問題。

brief_en: Anthropic opened a Singapore office and signed an AI-safety MOU with the government. Google DeepMind and Cloud granted up to 200 European researchers access to AlphaFold 3 and other science models plus $3M credits via the EU RAISE program. Anthropic also detailed Scion, its agent-scale source-control system that replaced Git after Claude-driven merges hit 30k/day.
brief_zh: Anthropic在新加坡開設辦公室並與政府簽署AI安全合作備忘錄。Google DeepMind與Cloud透過歐盟RAISE計畫，向最多200名歐洲研究人員開放AlphaFold 3等科學模型及300萬美元算力額度。Anthropic也公開Scion自建版本控制系統，以因應Claude帶動每日合併量從2500飆升至3萬。
